policy.calibrationSelection: First 12 chronologically nonoverlapping mature forecast windows; selected missing labels fail the block without replacement
policy.testSelection: Later chronologically nonoverlapping mature forecast windows; origin strictly later than the final calibration target date

futureProtocol.requiredLabels: Same-bound issued prospective records with preserved completed target observations actually collected before the new information cutoff
futureProtocol.calibrationRule: First 12 chronologically nonoverlapping qualifying records; retain each original record ID, observation ID and exact residual; freeze the rank and radius
futureProtocol.issueRule: Issue a separately versioned calibrated forecast only after that block is fixed; preserve the unmodified raw forecast and its original record, and explicitly reference its model.sourceHash separately from the new calibration wrapper hash
futureProtocol.evaluationRule: Only later issued origins strictly after the final calibration target; preserve all selected missing and failed outcomes without substitution
futureProtocol.retuningRule: A changed seed, source graph, radius selection or calibration policy starts a different experiment and cannot inherit held-out scores

evidence.reason: L1 transaction count is not execution gas.
Daily Mgas/s converted to gas; exact integer/canonical completeness has not been established.

requiredEvidence: Complete canonical UTC block range with integer gasUsed; retain missing blocks and reorg checks. A rounded Mgas/s conversion is a supplement.

evidence.reason: L1 transactions are not transactions on the fixed rollup universe.

requiredEvidence: Fixed chain identities and transaction inclusion policy for all 28 days; growthepie txcount filters positive gas_price or gas_used in the pinned query. Preserve per-chain missing days.
Integer blobGasUsed for every included canonical block, including zero-blob blocks; retain fork and capacity changes.

evidence.reason: Total fees already include blob fees; the execution/blob split is absent.

requiredEvidence: Sum gasUsed * effectiveGasPrice from execution receipts only; do not relabel total fees including blobs as execution fees.

evidence.reason: Total fees include priority transfers and blobs; they are not execution burn.

requiredEvidence: Per-block baseFeePerGas * gasUsed in exact wei across the canonical UTC window; priority fees are transfers, not burn.

Canonical execution traces and pre/post-state balances must reconcile non-fee destruction across the exact UTC window. EIP-6780 retains destruction for a newly created contract in the same transaction. Neither absent events nor transfers to apparently inaccessible addresses establish protocol destruction or a measured zero.

evidence.reason: The total does not identify its blob component.

requiredEvidence: Exact blobGasUsed * protocol integer blob base fee, or reconciled blob receipt fees, under the applicable fork schedule; TRUNC(EXP(...)) is not the integer fake_exponential algorithm.

evidence.reason: The total does not identify blob fee burn.

requiredEvidence: A verified blobFeesEth series supports the equal burn amount under the cited rule; equality is not permission to fill an unobserved amount with zero.

evidence.reason: Gross network issuance does not subtract consensus penalties or establish layer accounting.

requiredEvidence: Exact consensus creation minus all consensus destruction for the UTC window, excluding deposits/withdrawals and fee transfers.

Pinned growthepie CL series has theoretical issuance for 2025-05-07 through 2026-01-01, an interpolated participation factor, and a two-day Shapella redistribution; current epoch-normalized hourly means also require boundary reconciliation.

evidence.reason: A combined issuance field does not prove a PoW-only value.
Sourced protocol-zero partial observation for the fully post-transition canonical range.

requiredEvidence: Use the existing sourced EIP-3675 post-transition canonical-range receipt; never infer zero from absent IssTotNtv data. Retain provider-only canonical/finalized limitations.

evidence.reason: Execution/consensus supply and revision scope remain unreconciled.

requiredEvidence: Reconciled execution plus consensus supply at the exact window end, with deposits/withdrawals as transfers and a revision trail; do not subtract staked ETH.

All contract-defined staking balances including pending exits at window end. Pinned growthepie active actual balance excludes nonactive balances; its fallback can be effective balance and daily data can use start_balance.
Validator-status and actual-balance stock at the same end state; exclude withdrawn balances and avoid treating completed exits as the pending queue.
Same fixed L2 universe as transactions and settlement; execution, data and operator user charges once each; dated native-token conversion where needed.

evidence.reason: No fixed-rollup settlement subset is identified.

requiredEvidence: Same fixed L2 universe and identified L1 settlement transactions; execution plus blob charges exactly once. rent_paid derived views can fill missing dates; obtain missingness/provenance instead of treating all displayed zeroes as observed.
Earned gross rewards for the fixed validator/investor cohort, with disjoint total/component API accounting; net CL rewards or ideal rewards cannot substitute.
Actual penalties and slashing destruction of the same cohort; missing penalties are not zero.
Priority fees actually earned by identified cohort proposers/fee recipients, separate from issuance and other builder payments.
Reconciled execution/builder transfers to the same cohort after removing priority fees already counted; unknown decomposition remains missing.
Actual pool/operator/custody charges to those investors, with each expense counted once. A network APR does not provide this field.
Actual residual operating expenses and dated non-ETH conversion; never use an assumed APR haircut or zero default.
Time-weighted eligible principal for precisely the cohort earning all recorded reward/cost components; a final active-balance stock is not the denominator.
Count from the fixed sample of exits completed within the UTC window; keep the request and execution-availability event pair.
Median elapsed duration over that same completed sample, not pending-queue clearance time; zero completed exits leaves the median missing.

Fixed protocol/asset/chain coverage and backing identifiers at window end; deduplicate ETH/WETH, bridges and lending receipts. Latest USD divided by latest ETH price is not a unique-underlying ledger.
Recursive LST/LRT/wrapper backing units disjoint from native collateral. Subtracting aggregate LST categories does not establish unique underlying units.

definitionFinding.reason: EIP-6780 retains same-transaction SELFDESTRUCT burns. A fee-only supply identity is incomplete without measured non-fee destruction or affirmative exact-window zero evidence.

slots.usageMeaning: Grouped source fields have unestablished aggregate/average semantics. Fractional blob presentation is retained; gas and blob presentation values are never summed or converted into model usage.

endpointArithmetic.convention: Treat supplyWei as the end of each reported contiguous bucket and compare the later row netWei. This convention check does not establish source clock semantics.

epochs.usageMeaning: Grouped source fields have unestablished aggregate/average semantics. Fractional blob presentation is retained; gas and blob presentation values are never summed or converted into model usage.

endpointArithmetic.convention: Treat supplyWei as the end of each reported contiguous bucket and compare the later row netWei. This convention check does not establish source clock semantics.

utcWindow.interpretation: Bucket sums remain provider claims even when integer arithmetic and requested slot boundaries align. No proration, missing-zero fill, or epoch-to-UTC relabeling.

feasibility.limitation: Completed execution-layer exits are required. Earliest activation-day origin is only an optimistic bound; actual exits, complete observations and publication/collection receipts can make eligibility later. Nonoverlapping labels are not independent regimes.
